remarks: Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Cape Cod located in the Village of Albion! Offering a versatile layout and plenty of living space, this home features an enclosed front porch, a spacious double-wide blacktop driveway, and a convenient 2-car attached garage. Inside, the first floor offers a bright eat-in kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space, flowing into a generously sized living room that provides a comfortable space to relax or entertain. A first-floor bedroom, half bath, and dedicated laundry room add to the home's everyday convenience. Upstairs, you'll find two additional well-sized bedrooms and a full bathroom. The large basement offers even more potential, featuring a partially finished area and a second full bathroom, making it ideal for a recreation room, home gym, or additional gathering space. Outside, enjoy the spacious backyard with a large patio and hot tub, perfect for entertaining or unwinding at the end of the day. A storage shed provides extra room for tools and outdoor equipment. With its flexible floor plan, attached garage, outdoor entertaining space, and convenient village location close to local amenities, this home offers plenty of possibilities to make it your own!
